//maxWorkers: Every e2e suite runs against the one real Postgres database and truncates it in beforeEach. Run in parallel they wipe each other mid-test, and the failures are misleading — unrelated 404s and phantom reconciliation mismatches. Serial is not a performance compromise here; it is what makes a green run mean anything. Pinned in the config rather than passed on the command line so it holds however the suite is invoked.
